0;font-weight:500}.story-bridge{background:var(--deep);color:white}.story-bridge .story-intro{color:#d9e4da}.story-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);list-style:none;padding:0;margin:55px 0 0}.story-steps li{border-top:1px solid #b2c4b96b;padding:32px 20px
